name: Botulinum neurotoxin serotype A, B and E toxicity
rationale: All three members are botulinum toxin intoxication pathways for serotypes A, B and E, which separates the theme from the C, D and G serotypes and from cholinergic release or receptor themes.

qualifier: tRNA aminoacylation and peptidyl amino acid modification
name: tRNA aminoacylation, tRNA modification and peptidyl amino acid modification
rationale: Members cover tRNA charging (cytosolic and mitochondrial), tRNA wobble and wybutosine modification and amino acid modification of proteins such as diphthamide, hypusine and hydroxylation, unlike neighbours centred on protein methylation, rRNA/tRNA processing or translation termination.

qualifier: second heart field and cardiac mesoderm specification
name: Early heart morphogenesis and second heart field specification
rationale: All members concern early heart formation from cardiac mesoderm (heart tube, cardiogenesis, myoblast differentiation, right ventricle, pericardium), with second heart field specification and proliferation distinguishing it from septal, outflow tract and coronary themes.

core: Neural progenitor proliferation and neuronal differentiation
name: Neuroblast proliferation and sympathoadrenal neuron development
rationale: Members regulate neuroblast and forebrain progenitor division and neuronal differentiation, and the noradrenergic, sympathetic ganglion and adrenal members distinguish it from midbrain, glial and forebrain patterning neighbours.

name: Connexin assembly, trafficking and gap junction turnover
rationale: All members describe the connexin life cycle (oligomerization, secretory and microtubule transport, annular gap junction internalization, activity regulation), unlike neighbours about cardiac electrical conduction or neuronal signalling.

qualifier: de novo IMP, AMP and GMP synthesis
name: De novo purine ribonucleotide biosynthesis
rationale: Members describe de novo synthesis of IMP and its conversion to AMP, XMP and GMP, distinguishing it from pyrimidine synthesis, purine salvage and nucleotide catabolism neighbours.

name: Nuclear pore complex assembly and non-mRNA cargo transport
rationale: Members concern nuclear pore complex assembly, disassembly and localization plus transport of ribosomal subunits, inositol phosphates and Rev cargo, unlike neighbours about nuclear envelope breakdown, SUMOylation or mRNA export.

qualifier: vesicle endocytic recycling and postsynaptic receptor trafficking
name: Synaptic vesicle recycling and postsynaptic receptor trafficking
rationale: Members span presynaptic vesicle endocytosis, clathrin coat dynamics and active zone organization plus postsynaptic receptor internalization and AMPA receptor trafficking, separating it from vesicle docking/fusion, Rab endosomal recycling and plasticity neighbours.

name: Osmoregulation via vasopressin, aquaporins and cation-chloride cotransporters
rationale: Members concern osmotic responses and renal water and sodium handling through vasopressin, aquaporins and SLC12 cotransporters, distinguishing it from renin-angiotensin and magnesium/tight junction neighbours.

name: Clathrin coat dynamics in synaptic vesicle endocytosis
rationale: All members concern clathrin coat assembly/disassembly and clathrin-dependent synaptic vesicle endocytosis and recycling, unlike neighbours about active zone structure, postsynaptic receptors or lysosome-related organelle coating.

qualifier: amino acid conjugation of aromatic acids
name: Glycine-threonine catabolism and amino acid conjugation of aromatic acids
rationale: Members cover glycine and threonine degradation and glycine/glutamine conjugation of benzoate, salicylate and phenylacetate, distinguishing it from proline, alanine and generic amino acid metabolism neighbours.

qualifier: stem cell regulation and erythroid-megakaryocytic differentiation
name: Hematopoietic stem cell regulation and erythroid-megakaryocytic differentiation
rationale: Members concern hematopoietic stem and progenitor cell control and red cell and megakaryocyte/platelet differentiation (RUNX1, erythroid and platelet modules), unlike granulocyte/monocyte or stem cell maintenance neighbours.

name: Prostaglandin and leukotriene synthesis and receptor signaling
rationale: Members cover cyclooxygenase prostanoid and leukotriene biosynthesis, their GPCRs and responses, separating it from lipoxin/HETE, P450 epoxygenase and histamine neighbours.

name: Trk neurotrophin receptor downstream kinase and transcriptional signaling
rationale: Members describe TRKA and TRKB effector signalling (PI3K/AKT, ERK5, p38, CDK5, RAC1, CREB, NGF-stimulated transcription), distinguishing it from proximal NTRK2 ligand activation and p75NTR neighbours.

qualifier: chamber, valve, septum and outflow tract morphogenesis
name: Cardiac chamber, valve, septum and outflow tract morphogenesis
rationale: Members span the morphogenesis of heart chambers, valves, septa, endocardial cushions, outflow tract and conduction system, unlike endothelial/vasculogenesis, gap junction conduction or cardiomyocyte proliferation neighbours.

qualifier: ADAR RNA editing, PKR and OAS
name: Type I interferon response with ADAR editing, PKR and OAS
rationale: Members combine interferon-alpha response and its negative regulation with the dsRNA-handling effectors ADAR (A-to-I editing), PKR and OAS, which distinguishes it from TLR and RIG-I sensing neighbours.

name: Peroxisomal beta-oxidation and medium-chain acyl-CoA metabolism
rationale: Members cover acyl-CoA oxidase-dependent beta-oxidation of very long chain and pristanoyl-CoA plus medium-chain, malonyl- and succinyl-CoA metabolism, unlike alpha-oxidation, carnitine shuttle and ALD neighbours.

name: Lipoprotein, cholesterol and bile acid metabolism
rationale: Members cover lipoprotein assembly, remodelling and clearance, cholesterol homeostasis and bile acid synthesis and transport, distinguishing it from xenobiotic/bilirubin transport and adipose triglyceride storage neighbours.

name: ESCRT-III nuclear envelope sealing and cytokinetic abscission
rationale: All members concern ESCRT-III-driven mitotic nuclear envelope resealing and midbody abscission, unlike neighbours about multivesicular bodies, viral budding or lamina depolymerization.

name: Neuropeptide and opioid GPCR signaling promoting wakefulness
rationale: Members describe neuropeptide and opioid G protein signalling and dense-core vesicle release, with orexin and wakefulness members distinguishing it from sleep, stress and drug-response behaviour neighbours.

name: Microglial activation and amyloid-beta or excitotoxic neuronal injury
rationale: Members concern microglial and astrocyte activation together with amyloid-beta and kainate-induced hippocampal neuron injury, unlike neighbours about microglial phagocytosis, differentiation or amyloid clearance.

name: Amyloid-beta clearance and amyloid fibril formation
rationale: All members regulate amyloid-beta clearance or amyloid fibril formation, distinguishing it from neighbours about amyloid-beta production, glial responses and tau tangles.

qualifier: pro-fission with protein localization to mitochondria
name: Pro-fission mitochondrial dynamics and protein localization to mitochondria
rationale: Members promote mitochondrial fission and fragmentation, inhibit fusion, modulate membrane potential and localize proteins to mitochondria, unlike PINK1-Parkin mitophagy, apoptotic permeabilization and mitochondrial import machinery neighbours.

qualifier: germinal center and plasma cell differentiation
name: B cell signatures and germinal center-plasma cell differentiation
rationale: Members are B cell, memory and plasma cell expression signatures plus germinal center, Tfh and plasma cell differentiation regulation, which neighbours focused on B cell homeostasis, BCR or CD27 signalling lack.

name: Cellular cholesterol homeostasis via SREBP, LXR and LDL-receptor turnover
rationale: Members concern sterol sensing by SREBP and LXR, cholesterol uptake and efflux, and lipoprotein receptor internalization and lysosomal degradation, distinguishing it from neighbours about plasma lipoprotein assembly, triglyceride lipolysis and foam cells.
